description: This file defines the SameasTest class, a custom Twig test expression used to check if two variables are identical (using === in PHP). It is part of the Twig templating engine's test expressions within the Node ody.

classes.name: SameasTest
classes.description: A class extending TestExpression that implements a strict 'same as' comparison (=== in PHP) as a Twig test.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the custom 'Same as' expression into PHP code, outputting a strict comparison (===) between the 'node' and the first argument.
